The North Wind threw angrily at the cloak, but all his efforts were in vain. Then the Sun began to shine. At first his beams were gentle and in the pleasant warmth after the bitter cold of the norwing, the traveler of pasting his cloak and letting it unloose from his shoulders. The sun's rays grew warmer and warmer. The man took off his cap and mopped his brow. At last he became so heated that he pulled off his coat. And to escape the blazing sunshine, threw himself down in the welcome shade of a tree by the roadside.
